Bronze envelopes used by the Silver tests. Records come from the real Workshop 1 samples
(GVP volcanoes and eruptions, USGS feed of 2026-11-11, HANS monitored list) and the trimmed
Volcano Updates page. A few feed records were copied and edited on purpose to cover cases the
real week did not contain: ids starting with `hvtest` have no magnitude, no geometry, a
negative depth or the type `quarry blast`. Eruption 99999901 belongs to a non-US volcano number.
